label: المتعقّب التجريبي

admission.clientCapability: mafiaRulesets includes numeric 2; older protocol2 clients remain v1-only

composition: Replace the first drawn town support role with one tracker. V1 composition, default catalog, shuffle order and random calls stay unchanged. Other support positions remain randomly drawn.

selection.chargeConsumption: At night close, including blocked or failed uses

resolution.observation: Unique destinations of the tracked actor's accepted unblocked active ability and their own non-null Mafia attack ballot, in public seat order.
resolution.attackTie: An actor's accepted non-null ballot is a selection even when the team's aggregate ballot ties or the attack is protected.
resolution.absentBlockedOrPassive: No observed destinations; these causes are indistinguishable.
resolution.multipleTargets: Both analyst comparison targets and combined ability/attack destinations are merged without type labels or an ability-first order.
resolution.selfTargets: An allowed doctor or masker self-target can appear as a destination.
resolution.deadDestinations: An eliminated reporter target is a valid destination.
resolution.trackedActorDeath: Accepted selections remain observable when the tracked actor dies at the same resolution.
resolution.trackerDeath: No private tracking report is delivered when the tracker is dead after the resolution.
resolution.trackerBlocked: Generic no_result report if still alive; the committed charge is consumed.
resolution.conversion: The tracker retains role and remaining charges, and wins with the new faction. Tracking cannot identify conversion success.
resolution.masking: Masking changes apparent faction checks, never destinations.

informationBoundary.archive: Delayed authorized participant review, numeric seats only; no chat/audio/account identity.
informationBoundary.publicObservers: Unavailable because experimental rooms are private.

interactions.citizen: No outgoing night ability; empty destinations.
interactions.investigator: Investigation target is a destination regardless of apparent-faction result.
interactions.doctor: Protection selection is a destination even if no attack reaches it; self-protection follows normal constraints.
interactions.guard: Passive shield creates no outgoing destination.
interactions.observer: Observation target is a destination; tracking and activity evidence stay distinct.
interactions.reporter: The eliminated target selected for a reveal is a destination.
interactions.herald: Daytime extension creates no outgoing night destination.
interactions.analyst: Both selected comparison targets appear, deduplicated and ordered by seat.
interactions.mafia: Their individual accepted non-null attack ballot appears, without reporting aggregate attack success.
interactions.masker: Accepted masking target and own accepted attack ballot are merged without type labels.
interactions.blocker: Accepted blocking target and own accepted attack ballot are merged; blocking the tracker prevents its report.
interactions.leader: An accepted recruitment target is a destination even when recruitment fails; target identity does not reveal the failure reason.

steps: trace an actor with no outgoing choice
start a separate teaching room and resolve blocked tracking
localLab.persistence: Owner/course/version scoped decision journal; no room state, role assignment or secret chat persisted.

acceptance.reason: Implementation completed under the user's explicit request to skip tests. Build/deployment evidence is recorded separately by the release operator.
